draft.title: Bushido and samurai life
card: Samurai were warriors who served a daimyo. They lived by a code of loyalty, honour and self-discipline.
This code was later called bushido, which means the way of the warrior. It was a set of values more than a written law.
Loyalty meant faithful service to their lord. Honour meant living in a way that earned respect, and self-discipline meant controlling their own behaviour.
Samurai did not only train to fight. Many also studied poetry and the tea ceremony, which were seen as part of a well-rounded life.
draft.remember: Samurai life was shaped by the values of bushido, and it included the arts as well as fighting.

a.q: Which description best fits the code later called bushido?
opts: Values of loyalty, honour and self-discipline
Rules that let samurai choose their own lord
Laws that banned samurai from learning the arts
Orders from the emperor about how to farm rice
a.why: Bushido was a set of values about loyalty, honour and self-discipline. It did not ban the arts, because samurai also studied poetry and the tea ceremony.
a.clue: Think about the three values the code was built on.

b.q: Kenji is a young samurai. Besides sword practice, he spends his evenings writing poems and learning the tea ceremony. What does this show about samurai life?
opts: Samurai often studied the arts as well as fighting
Samurai were forbidden to train as warriors
Samurai were farmers who had no lord to serve
Samurai gave up bushido once they learned poetry
b.why: Many samurai studied poetry and tea ceremony as well as fighting, so Kenji's evenings fit samurai life. Learning the arts did not mean giving up bushido, as these skills were part of a well-rounded life.
b.clue: Samurai life was not only about fighting.

a.best: Values of loyalty, honour and self-discipline

b.best: Samurai often studied the arts as well as fighting

problems.detail: The right option is the only one with a qualifier ('often'). The wrong options are all absolute ('gave up', 'forbidden', 'had no lord'), so a student could pick the right answer without knowing the idea.
